description: Figure 6 prerequisite: test whether GaWF encoder Sector/Digit tuning is predominantly 6-by-6 spatial rather than 32-channel, and whether Sector-tuned units align with input-gate Sector modulation.
notes: Each seed streams balanced 90-cell condition means for 20 fixed draws; no raw activation or gate arrays are retained.
Validation encoder activations estimate tuning, while held-out test input-gate columns estimate gate modulation.
The final panel contains Sector and Digit 6-by-6 tuning maps, spatial/channel/interaction structure fractions, and tuning-to-gate alignment controls.
This completed per-unit ANOVA-style attempt was superseded before Fig6 interpretation; retain it for provenance, but do not use it as the Fig6 prerequisite.
